name: Suzunomiya Mayuki
source:
Mayuki is [url=https://vndb.org/c69165]Rikka[/url]'s patient who suffers from general paralysis since the disaster.

[spoiler]Her true name is Kamishina ( 神志那 ) Mayuki ( 真幸 ), she is [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url]'s second younger sister and the twin sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c14894]Miyuki[/url].

In 15 years, she couldn't get out of her room, only spoke with [url=https://vndb.org/c69165]Rikka[/url] and 3 nurses.

She has her brain connected to the "brain" of [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] in order to relearn how to use her legs, her arms ... Because of this microchip, she "sees" and feels all that [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] feels and experiences.

When [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] was awake, Mayuki was sleeping and when [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] was in maintenance, Mayuki woke up with data collected by [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] during her day. [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url] doesn't know about the existence of Mayuki, but Mayuki knows about [url=https://vndb.org/c14895]Meta[/url]. They have never seen each other because they don't "live" at the same time but alternately.

In her route, she express her jealousy toward her [url=https://vndb.org/c14894]twin sister[/url], not because of his physical health but because, unlike her, [url=https://vndb.org/c14894]Miyuki[/url] can go home every night with [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] by her side.[/spoiler]
